name: Samuel
summary: A prophet and judge, given to the LORD as a child by his mother Hannah, whom the LORD called by name in the night at Shiloh. He judged Israel all his life and anointed both Saul and David as king.

key_moments.title: Given to the LORD as a Child
key_moments.description: Hannah named her son Samuel, because she had asked him of the LORD. When he was weaned, she brought him to the house of the LORD in Shiloh.

key_moments.title: The LORD Calls in the Night
key_moments.description: The LORD called young Samuel by name, and three times he ran to Eli. The fourth time he answered the LORD and listened, and all Israel came to know he was the LORD's prophet.

key_moments.title: Prays for Victory at Mizpeh
key_moments.description: Samuel told Israel to put away their strange gods and gathered them at Mizpeh. As he offered a lamb, the LORD thundered against the Philistines, and Samuel set up a stone and named it Ebenezer.

key_moments.title: Israel Asks for a King
key_moments.description: The elders came to Samuel at Ramah and asked for a king like the other nations. The LORD told Samuel they had rejected Him, not Samuel, and Samuel warned them what a king would take from them.

key_moments.title: Anointing the Shepherd Boy
key_moments.description: The LORD sent Samuel to Jesse in Bethlehem and told him not to judge by outward appearance. Samuel anointed the youngest son, David, in front of his brothers.
